claims.statement: A St. Louis County warrant for prize-fighting, issued by Justice Caffrey, named Tom Allen among those charged for their part in the Kelly-McManus fight at Florissant.
claims.excerpt: and Tom Kelly, Tom Allen, Chariey Woods, im Brown, the referee, seconds, etc., in the fight

claims.statement: Tom Allen was arrested on the afternoon of 11 February 1889 and gave bond.
claims.excerpt: arrested by2o’tiock this afternoon and all gave bond

notes: The warrant text gives Allen's role only as one of the 'seconds, etc.' The bonds were $500 each. The arrest excerpt does not name Allen; his name is in the preceding line of the article.
